sources.title: LocateAnything-3B: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview LocateAnything-3B is a vision-language model for visual grounding and object localization built by nvidia. The model predicts bounding box coordinates and points from natural language queries, supporting tasks like referring expression grounding, multi-object detection, GUI element grounding, and text localization across complex scenes.
